# VPN clients unable to establish tunnel after maintenance window

Remote employees report they cannot connect to the corporate VPN; the client hangs at 'Negotiating security policies' and eventually times out.

A firmware update on the VPN concentrator reset the IKEv2 proposal list, dropping AES-256-GCM which the client profiles required, leaving no matching cipher proposal between peers.

1. Compare the pre- and post-maintenance IKEv2 proposal configuration on the concentrator
2. Re-add the AES-256-GCM / SHA-384 / DH group 20 proposal to the phase 2 policy
3. Force a re-key and confirm one pilot client establishes a tunnel
4. Roll out to all client profiles and monitor concentrator SA table

Error Details
```
IKE_SA phase 2 failed: NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN; strongSwan charon: received AUTHENTICATION_FAILED notify error; retransmit 5 of request message ID 0
```

Tags: vpn, ikev2, no-proposal-chosen, cipher-mismatch, strongswan
